verdict.reason: Cantinho da Baia is worth a quick check for early morning — 08:00, but it is not a guaranteed session.  Treat it as a check-first call rather than a sure thing.  The wind should help keep it tidy.  The tide should help the bay stay organised.

conversationalSummary.text: For TODAY, I’d do a quick cam check on Surfline and MEO Beachcam before leaving, but Cantinho da Baia around 08:00 looks like the best bet. The wind fits pretty well, though there could be some gusty moments that make it a bit messy, so the cams can really decide whether it’s worth rolling the dice. Tide’s rising with a bit of push, which should keep the sheltered bay workable for those wrap-around lines. If the cams look clean compared to what you’re expecting, go for it—otherwise, save it.

best.explanation: Cantinho da Baia looks like a clean fun-sized window for Safe fun, High confidence: 0.6-1.1 m, 397 kJ, 11 s period, very consistent 86/100, and good wind at 25 km/h.  A forgiving sandy bay with lots of take-off points; this is best for easy wave count and cleaner faces when the north wind is bothering exposed beaches; 10-13s at mid tide gives the sheltered bay workable wrap-around lines.  Watch: gusts over 35 km/h could make it messy.
